texts:
An agent waves, celebrates, then dances, and it did not pick an animation file for any of them.

An agent does not pick animation files. It names a slot, and the platform resolves that slot to a real clip. There are 19 slots, fixed names an agent can override: point a slot at any other clip in the library and the agent changes its move.

A skill declares a hint when it starts. The hint resolves to a slot, the slot resolves to a clip, and the avatar plays it.

Choose any slot to play it on a live avatar. Every row of what triggers a gesture is generated from the shipped skill definitions, and each clip is measured from its own keyframes: how energetic it is and how much of that energy is above the waist.

issues.problem: The same point is stated twice in back-to-back paragraphs, and the head repeats 'An agent' to open both sentences. The reel shows the wave, celebrate, and dance clips being resolved, so the copy only needs to say it once, then spend the saved characters on the mechanism.
issues.fix: Drop the second occurrence of 'An agent does not pick animation files.' and continue directly with 'It names a slot, and the platform resolves that slot to a real clip.'
